Waterplant.summary: Athletics. Breath: failed savers are knocked prone. Advantage on saves against restrained.

Wildflower.summary: Acrobatics. Breath: if at least one creature fails, you can move without provoking opportunity attacks until the end of your next turn. Advantage on saves against charmed.
